name: The Senior Dev
description: Communicates exclusively through code comments. You've never heard their voice.
passive: Reduces Tech Debt drift by 10% while in your party.
relationshipEvents: // noted.
// this is fine, probably.
// you again. good.
// I'd take a bullet for this repo. not for you though. the repo.
quitFlavorText: The Senior Dev pushes one last commit -- "// not my problem anymore" -- and goes quiet for good.

support.name: Emergency Cleanup
support.description: Clears Tech Debt back to zero.

name: The PM
description: Is always "just circling back on this." You're never sure what "this" was.
passive: Shields a little Runway each sprint. Buys you room from somewhere.
relationshipEvents: Just circling back on how you're doing!
Following up on my follow-up.
No agenda, just checking in. (There's an agenda.)
Honestly? You're doing better than the last dev on this project.
quitFlavorText: The PM stops circling back. Turns out there was never anything to follow up on.

support.name: Pitch to a Big Corp
support.description: Pitches you to a contact. Reputation boost.

name: The Figma-Obsessed Designer
description: Has strong opinions about four different shades of primary blue.
relationshipEvents: Quick question — thoughts on this blue vs. that blue?
I redid the button radius. You'll notice. You won't say anything.
You get it. Nobody else gets it.
I'm naming a color after you. It's a shade of blue.
quitFlavorText: The Designer stops sharing mockups. "Nobody was ever going to see it anyway."

support.name: Portfolio Flex
support.description: A slick case-study post goes up. Reputation burst.

name: The Intern
description: Chaotic. High variance. Once pushed directly to `main` and it was, somehow, fine.
passive: Each sprint, a coin flip: a small windfall, or a small mess.
relationshipEvents: hey!! is this normal
ok I fixed it. I think. don't check.
you're like a mentor to me. is that ok to say
I pushed to main again. it's fine this time. probably.
quitFlavorText: The internship ends. Or maybe you just wouldn't stop talking to them. Either way, they're gone.

support.name: "My Uncle Works at Microsoft"
support.description: Extremely rare. A big reputation and runway windfall, out of nowhere.

name: The QA Ghost
description: Already left the company. Still shows up to warn you before things go wrong.
passive: Highlights the correct item to use during an incident.
relationshipEvents: You should look at that thing before it looks at you.
I'm not really here. But I saw something. Be careful.
You're one of the good ones. Don't end up like me.
Something's coming. I can't say what. I never can.

support.name: Guard the Night
support.description: Guards you from incidents fully, for one night.
